issue.title: gateway: Kimi refuses a tool whose top-level schema has no type, and magpie doesn't recognise the refusal
issue.body: Found while fixing the Codex→Kimi `$defs` refusal (129d8b08a). Kimi/Moonshot refuses a request when a tool's top-level `parameters` has no `type`. Its error is: `tools.function.parameters.type is required and must be "object"`. magpie folds such a schema into an object only after a refusal it recognises, and this wording isn't one of them, so the request just fails. Codex always sends a typed top level, so chaosy's report doesn't hit this, but another client can. Fix idea: in kimi_schema.go, set the top-level `type: object` before sending to Kimi/Moonshot hosts, or add this wording to the refusals magpie recognises. Add a test on the Chat, Anthropic and Responses routes.

comments.body:
Published a fix in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/2bddfe100fe475615250d7612de8619bef9cb3af

The gateway now recognizes the reported `tools.function.parameters.type is required and must be "object"` refusal and reuses its existing object-root retry and provider/model/upstream-protocol memory. Recognizing the wording alone was insufficient: both the relayed body repair and the translated schema repair had a union-only fast exit, so schemas with `properties` but no `type` were still left untyped. Those paths now repair the missing root type too.

The first refusal is retried with an object root; the next turn goes in the accepted shape directly. An upstream accepting the original schema keeps it. The regression retains the nested string property, `required` and `additionalProperties: false`; this does not blindly replace all nested types with objects or classify unrelated nested-property/type errors as this refusal. The contract is documented in gateway-routing. No new state, configuration or dependency.

Verification at this exact head, Go 1.26.8, isolated HOME with pinned caches:
- Restoring the parent's `object_root.go` with the new tests gives the reported 400 on all six routes: Chat, Anthropic Messages and Responses clients to Chat or Responses upstreams. The refusal-wording test also fails.
- Fixed new tests and existing root-union tests pass with `-race -count=5`. Twelve route cases cover refusing/accepting upstreams, exactly one retry, remembered next-turn behavior and retained constraints; wording negatives cover a nested field, a different type and an unrelated field.
- All seven acceptance checks pass: native/Linux/Windows vet and builds, plus `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` (69 packages passed). Gofmt and whitespace checks are clean.

Combined branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-20261023-r

No live Kimi account was used: the quoted message is the issue's verbatim text inside a synthetic OpenAI error envelope, exercised through the real gateway handler and local HTTP upstreams. Cross-platform vet/builds are not native Windows/macOS runtime checks. No GUI assets or installed agent configs changed, and no upstream PR opened.
